notes:
{栄養|えいよう} covers both the nutrients themselves and the concept of being well-nourished. It appears frequently in health, food, and medical contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {栄養|えいよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be nutritious
- {栄養|えいよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to get nutrition
- {栄養|えいよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: to lack nutrition
- {栄養|えいよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{偏|かたよ}る→偏る：07872_katayoru⟧: to have unbalanced nutrition
- {栄養|えいよう}⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧: nutritional balance

- {栄養|えいよう}{士|し}: nutritionist, dietitian
- {栄養|えいよう}⟦{素|そ}→栄養素：06207_eiyouso⟧: nutrient
- {栄養|えいよう}⟦{失調|しっちょう}→栄養失調：21221_eiyoushicchou⟧: malnutrition
